title: Ticket Claim Guard & Claim Command Update
summary: The HelpDesk bot now prevents repeated claim/unclaim spam and adds direct claim controls for ticket channels.
added: Added `/claim` so support staff and admins can claim the current ticket directly.
Added `/unclaim` so the current claimant or an admin can unclaim the current ticket directly.
Ticket claim and unclaim actions now post Ticket Command Activity records inside the ticket.
changed: The claim button now claims only; pressing it again no longer toggles the ticket back and forth.
Claiming is blocked when the ticket is already claimed by the same person or another staff member.
Unclaiming is blocked when the ticket is not currently claimed.
Existing `/ticket admin` claim and unclaim actions now reject invalid repeat actions.
Support instructions keep the corrected Grey R. mention: <@1263248306264608871>.
